name: Caddow
tagline: Coats and knitwear, made in runs of forty.
description: Caddow makes coats and knitwear in undyed wool, waxed cotton and linen: forty of each piece, cut by hand in a workroom in Marrowby, and sold here.
shareImageAlt: Caddow — a woman in a long rust coat against a sunlit harbour wall
footerText: Caddow is a fictional label. Every coat, person, shop and town on this site is invented, and the shop is a demo until it is connected to a store.
